message.Title: Generally Available: Summary rules in Log Analytics workspace now support manual “Retry bin”

Body.Content:
Summary rules run batch aggregation inside your Log Analytics workspace and re-ingest the summarized results into a custom destination table. When a bin fails, that can create gaps in your summarized dataset. “Retry bin” helps you remediate bin-level failures without redefining rules or rebuilding tables.

“Retry bin” capability lets you re-run a specific failed time bin in case the service’s built-in retry policy is exhausted. To retry, you provide a retryBinStartTime value; the rule’s existing configuration (query, binSize, destination table, etc.) remains unchanged.
Learn more.
